name: Sergio Gor

lean.basis: Longtime Republican and Trump political operative; director of presidential personnel, then Trump's ambassador to India.

race_2028.basis: Co-founded Winning Team Publishing with Trump Jr. in 2021.

summary: Sergio Gor co-founded the conservative publisher Winning Team Publishing with Donald Trump Jr. in 2021, ran Trump's White House Presidential Personnel Office from January 2025, and was sworn in as ambassador to India in November 2025.
